info.title: SmartNote API Documentation
info.description:
Welcome to the SmartNote API docs!

This API documentation details all endpoints for the SmartNote backend, including authentication, topics, tags, tasks, memory maps, and ChatGPT integrations.

Authentication: Secure endpoints require a Bearer JWT token.
Contact: support@example.com
Base URL: http://localhost:3003

Note: All endpoints prefer and produce application/json.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token in the format: Bearer {token}
